title: BR-MoE: Budgeted Semantic Release for Privacy-Preserving Traffic Analytics
abstract: arXiv:2610.27026v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Traffic cameras support useful analysis, but their outputs can reveal private information. Replacing images with text reduces direct visual exposure. It does not place a formal bound on disclosure. The published reinforcement learning and mixture-of-experts framework refines scene descriptions through relevance, coverage, and brevity rewards. It does not account for repeated releases under a fixed privacy budget. This paper proposes budgeted semantic release as an extension of that framework. Four scene experts first process isolated video chunks. Their outputs are mapped to a fixed, bounded semantic schema. A reinforcement learning controller selects which expert summaries to release and how much privacy budget to spend. The controller uses public task requests and previous private releases. A separate privacy filter enforces the total budget. Calibrated noise is added before the summaries are converted to text. Under explicit chunk i

translated_title: BR-MoE：面向隐私保护交通分析的预算化语义发布
translated_abstract: 交通摄像头支持有用的分析，但其输出可能泄露私人信息。用文本替代图像可以减少直接的视觉暴露，但这并不能对信息泄露提供形式化的界限。已发表的强化学习与混合专家框架通过相关性、覆盖度和简洁性奖励来优化场景描述，但并未考虑在固定隐私预算下的重复发布问题。本文提出了预算化语义发布，作为对该框架的扩展。四个场景专家首先分别处理相互隔离的视频片段，其输出被映射到一个固定且有界的语义模式上。强化学习控制器根据公共任务请求和先前的私有发布，决定发布哪些专家摘要以及花费多少隐私预算。一个独立的隐私过滤器负责强制执行总预算。在校准噪声加入之后，摘要才会被转换为文本。在显式片段i……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出BR-MoE框架，利用混合专家网络与强化学习控制器，在固定差分隐私预算约束下选择性发布交通视频的语义摘要，从而实现隐私保护的交通分析。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes BR-MoE, a framework that uses a mixture-of-experts architecture and a reinforcement learning controller to selectively release semantic summaries of traffic video under a fixed differential privacy budget, enabling privacy-preserving traffic analytics.
